'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 bombing of Odesa]]
****Four Russian [[missile]]s strike the Ukrainian port city of [[Odesa]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/missiles-hit-ukraines-coastal-city-odesa-regional-administration-2022-05-07/ (Reuters)]
***[[Siege of Mariupol]]
****[[Ukraine]] says that all women, children, and elderly have been evacuated from the besieged [[Azovstal iron and steel works|Azovstal steel plant]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/diplomatic-efforts-seek-save-ukraine-fighters-mariupol-zelenskiy-2022-05-07/ (Reuters)]
***[[Bilohorivka school bombing]]
****[[Russia]]n forces bomb a school in [[Bilohorivka, Sievierodonetsk Raion]], [[Luhansk Oblast]]. Only two deaths are confirmed but sixty people are believed to have been killed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-azovstal-steelworks-evacuation-focuses-wounded-medics-2022-05-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[Al-Qaeda insurgency in Yemen]]
**Two [[colonel]]s, two [[Yemeni Army|soldiers]] and four [[Al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula|al-Qaeda]] [[insurgent]]s are killed during clashes in [[Dhale Governorate]], [[Yemen]]. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-arrests-united-arab-emirates-yemen-terrorism-738272ea0278fdc46338a50bb1400188 (AP)]
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**Ten soldiers and one officer are killed during an attack at a [[security checkpoint|checkpoint]] at a [[water pumping]] station in the [[Suez Canal]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/eleven-egyptian-security-personnel-killed-after-foiling-terrorist-attack-army-2022-05-07/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**The Airline Operators of [[Nigeria]] announces that all of [[List of airlines of Nigeria|their airlines]] will suspend their domestic flights beginning on Monday, in protest of rising fuel prices caused by the war in Ukraine. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-61361686 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wildfires in 2022]]
**Eight people are killed and 17 others injured during [[wildfire]]s in [[Krasnoyarsk Krai]], [[Siberia]], [[Russia]], that destroy hundreds of buildings in 16 settlements. The [[Federal Agency for Forestry (Russia)|Federal Agency for Forestry]] blames high winds for worsening the fires and impacting [[firefighting]] efforts. [https://www.reuters.com/world/fires-kill-least-8-people-siberia-high-winds-hamper-rescue-2022-05-07/ (Reuters)]
*Three people are injured in an explosion at a steel coke plant in [[Jharkhand]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/blast-indias-tata-steel-coke-plant-injures-three-contract-workers-2022-05-07/ (Reuters)]
*Four Vietnamese nationals are killed when a fire breaks out at Bismark House Mill in [[Oldham]] [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-manchester-62428929?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=KARANGA (BBC)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
***[[Taiwan]] reports a record 46,536 new [[COVID-19]] cases in the past 24 hours, which is the first time the country has reported more than 40,000 cases since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://focustaiwan.tw/society/202205070007 (Focus Taiwan)]
*The [[monkeypox virus]] is detected in a person who recently travelled to [[England]] from [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-61363896 (BBC News)] 

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Treatment of women by the Taliban]]
**The [[Taliban]] passes a law ordering all [[women in Afghanistan]] to cover their faces in public with a [[burqa]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-announce-women-must-cover-faces-public-say-burqa-is-best-2022-05-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Iran]] preemptively shuts down the [[internet]] in [[Khuzestan province]] amid protests against a 200% increase in bread prices. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202205068794 (Iran International)]
*One person is killed and six others injured in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Cancún]], [[Quintana Roo]], [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-caribbean-cda0bb9930ec030dc1e5431e1dea3c3b (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[May 2022 Northern Ireland Assembly election|2022 Northern Ireland Assembly election]]
**[[Irish republicanism|Irish republican]] party [[Sinn Féin]] win the most seats in the [[Northern Ireland Assembly]] with 29% of the [[Single transferable vote|first-preference vote]], marking the first time that a [[Unionism in Ireland|unionist]] party did not win the most seats since [[Northern Ireland]]'s establishment in 1921. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/may/07/sinn-fein-assembly-victory-fuels-debate-on-future-of-union (''The Guardian'')]
*Former president of Brazil [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] announces his candidacy for the [[2022 Brazilian general election|upcoming Brazilian presidential election]] in October, launching his candidacy with a message of "hope" and stating that he is ready to make "the greatest peaceful revolution" in the history of Brazil. [https://www.efe.com/efe/america/politica/lula-lanza-su-candidatura-para-las-elecciones-presidenciales-de-brasil/20000035-4800755/ (EFE)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Kentucky Derby]]
**The 148th [[Kentucky Derby]] is held in [[Louisville, Kentucky]] with a full capacity for the first time [[2019 Kentucky Derby|since 2019]] after two years of [[COVID-19]] capacity restrictions. American [[thoroughbred]] [[Rich Strike]] wins the Derby in one of the largest upsets in history with an 80–1 odds to win. [https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/rich-strike-kentucky-derby-2022/ (CBS News)] [https://abcnews.go.com/Sports/wireStory/80-shot-rich-strike-races-huge-upset-kentucky-84568854 (ABC News)]
